# PropertyIQ

> AI-powered real estate market intelligence platform that ranks 925 US metros, 3,100+ counties, and 33,000+ ZIP codes.

## Overview

PropertyIQ uses machine learning to predict real estate market performance. The platform generates a single PropertyIQ Score (1-99) that predicts market performance using 3 Redfin demand-signal metrics (% Sold Above List, Median DOM, Months of Supply). Validated across 13 years of data with a 100% year hit rate — top-scored markets outperformed bottom-scored markets in every single test window.

## Scoring System

PropertyIQ generates a single **PropertyIQ Score** (1-99) for every geography:

- **50 = state average** — higher means outperformance relative to the state
- Built from 3 Redfin demand-signal metrics: % Sold Above List (positive), Median Days on Market (negative), Months of Supply (negative)
- Each metric is z-scored within the state, combined into a signal, then percentile-ranked and re-centered at 55.6, clamped 1-99
- Coverage: 746 metros, 2,983 counties, 19,880 ZIPs

### Validation Results

Validated across 13 years of walk-forward data (2012-2025):
- 100% year hit rate: top-quintile markets outperformed bottom-quintile in every single test window
- Top-scored markets delivered +3.05% excess return vs state average over 3 years
- Bottom-scored markets delivered -3.34% excess return vs state average over 3 years
- Monotonic quintile separation: performance increases consistently from Q1 to Q5

## Data Sources

| Source | Metrics | Update Frequency |
|--------|---------|-----------------|
| Realtor.com | Active listings, median prices, days on market | Monthly |
| Zillow | ZHVI home values, ZORI rent indices, inventory | Monthly |
| Redfin | Sale prices, price drops, new listings | Weekly |
| U.S. Census Bureau | Population, income, housing units (ACS) | Annual |
| FRED | Mortgage rates, GDP, macroeconomic indicators | Monthly |
| BLS | Unemployment rates, employment statistics | Monthly |
| BEA | Regional GDP, personal income | Quarterly |

## Coverage

- 925 metropolitan statistical areas (MSAs)
- 3,100+ counties
- 33,000+ ZIP codes
- 2,400,000+ properties analyzed
- 64+ data points per market
- Monthly data updates

## Pricing

- **Free**: 5 property lookups/month, basic scores, metro-level data
- **Pro** ($29/month): Unlimited lookups, full score breakdown, AI-generated reports, ZIP-level data
- **Team** ($99/month): Everything in Pro plus team collaboration, API access, and custom reports

## Competitors

PropertyIQ differentiates from competitors through validated predictive scores:
- vs Mashvisor: 4.6x more market coverage (925 vs ~200 metros), monthly updates vs quarterly
- vs NeighborhoodScout: AI-powered predictive scores vs descriptive analytics
- vs Reventure: Granular ZIP-level data vs metro-level only
